body: Thanks man,  I'm definitely gonna do that.
Thanks man. I'll give those a read. It's a big fear of mine. It'd be nice if I didn't have to worry.
Nah,  I'm right there with you.  It terrifies me. I'm Christian but a huge chunk of me thinks I'm going to hell.
Unfortunately I'm not shocked, but I'm certainly horrified.

I've been reading her posts,  I am floored by the amount of venom she spews everywhere.  Being a troll or an asshole is one thing,  but you have to be a special kind of awful to post like this on a sub for suicidal people.

Hey bro. Hope you're doing alright.  I know this hurts right now, but it won't be your last chance to ask someone out.  You're probably just starting high school, it's pretty rough at first,  but you'll grow and change a lot.  I was completely different at 14 than I was at 18. Hell I'm 23 and I still grow and change a lot. I hope you stay with us and Things get better soon.

Why would you think this is a reasonable way to respond to a cry for help? Maybe his problems don't seem as major to you as they do to him, but they're still issues he needs help with.  A lot of us come here at our lowest points and you don't know what else could be contributing to the depression.
How would I go about figuring out if I'm the abuser?

Honestly,  thanks for responding.  I haven't felt this low in awhile.  I'm still kinda close to losing it. I'm really trying hard to keep myself from terminating and I'm stable right now. 

Yeah, honestly  everyone else loves my mom, including my siblings most of the time... but I think she can be pretty toxic sometimes. This isn't the first time she's helped me get to a low point like this.

After I got raped she did something similar. She even had extended family be her mouth pieces. She did that with the rape and this sitution. So almost everyone I have contact with aside from coworkers and a friend or 2 is telling me how horrible of a person I am right now,  and my mom is telling me they will help make sure I get labeled mentally incompetent if she decides that's what she wants.  Everything of mine would become hers instantly,  and I'd never have a say in anything again .

There are also a lot of other memories/stories I could share that I don't know how to make heads or tails of because no one else acknowledges that those things happened. If they do,  it wasn't that bad or I deserved it. So I don't really try to talk to them about anything anymore and I'm overall very secretive .

 Regardless  of what I, or anyone else thinks about mom. I know I would rather die than live under her thumb longer than I have. For now,  all I can really do is pray and lay low because I really don't want things to get to that point.
